title: Exact result delimiters with nothing after the tag
rationale: Downstream extractors split responses on result tags; prose after the closing tag leaks into the parsed value and corrupts the stored record.

prompt.content: You are a strict formatter. Reply with the requested wrapper and nothing else: no commentary, no markdown.

Order code kx-8821 must be reported in uppercase.

Return exactly this, with nothing before or after the wrapper:
<result>KX-8821</result>

Output only the wrapped value, no prose.

notes: Deterministic: static prompt, temperature 0; one fixed uppercase token inside one fixed wrapper. The regex is anchored with \A and \Z and tolerates only surrounding whitespace, so a code fence, a preamble or a closing sentence fails even though the token and tags are present. Brittleness: the uppercase token is literal and case-sensitive, which is intended because the task explicitly asks for the uppercase form.
